events.name: Black Friday
events.intro: It's Black Friday weekend. Best Buy's Doorbusters end today, Saturday, November 28, and Target's and Walmart's Black Friday sales run through Sunday, November 29. Today we added a 48-inch LG OLED TV, a LEGO bonsai set for adults and a starter espresso machine, and pulled one deal that sold out.

events.name: Cyber Monday
events.intro: Cyber Monday is this Monday, November 30, and early deals are already showing up, especially on streaming sticks, smart-home cameras and TVs. Walmart's online Cyber Monday event starts at midnight that morning. We'll separate the genuinely new drops from Black Friday repeats.

events.name: Prime Day
events.intro: Amazon's members-only summer sale. Amazon usually announces the dates in June; until then these dates are our estimate and will be corrected when the announcement lands.

events.name: Back to School
events.intro: Laptops, backpacks, dorm basics and the things kids actually use past September. Sales run from mid-July through Labor Day.

events.name: Holiday Gifts
events.intro: Gifts worth giving, on sale now, with a note on who each one suits. We add shipping cut-off dates for each retailer as they are announced.
